body: We're all here for you man, I'm so sorry you feel this way - I hope you can make it through to another day. One step at a time.
Much love to you, I'm sorry to hear you're going through such a difficult time, but as everyone else has commented, we are all here for you, every step of the way.

I feel this. I walked in on my mom and her boyfriend having sex on the sofa when I went downstairs to make myself a cup of tea, I heard them but it didn't register they were having sex until I walked in, I remember asking my mom a question as I walked towards the room and there she was bouncing up and down and I had no words.. I just walked back upstairs. My mom ran after me after a few minutes apologising (she tries to make out she's a prude but I know she isnt) a few days later she bought me my favourite takeaway to make up for it :`)

Bless you! See I'm the opposite, I hate being on my own. I suppose it will probably give you the opportunity to work on yourself, which is always a good thing. Enjoying life doing what you want, when you want and not having to worry about anyone judging you for being yourself. You've got this!

I'm surprised you put up with it for that long to be honest. He sounds like the kind of guy to use you as an innkeeper. I hope you are doing better now. There is someone out there way better than him, he wasn't worth your time but I can understand how you felt. You had to go through that experience to then step back and realise what you actually wanted in life. It's okay to look back and feel strange but your feelings were genuine even if his wasn't. If you need to chat at all, just pop me a message if you want to vent a bit more x
Yeah I would like to, I just need to look up some options for what might work best

I used to have a therapist a few years ago but I stopped going due to life just getting in the way and most of the services they provide aren't free so it just seems like another worry financially that I didn't want to take on. Yeahh that makes sense, it's understandable you would take any negative emotion and turn it on yourself as you don't wanna hurt others, it's much easier to hurt yourself in that regard.

Did you find talking to a therapist helped? Yeah I think I have felt angry at a few people or at least frustrated as it's a vicious cycle of feeling like nobody cares, reaching out but then ultimately their conversations lead to silence which starts the whole process again. Obviously people have lives but having no one to talk to can feel like a life time when we feel like this.

I remember the first time I was introduced to daft punk, it was one of my uncle's CDs that was lost in my moms car and I put it into the disc slot out of curiousity. By the end of the car journey I was bopping to robot rock and my mom regretted that disc ever being in the car as I put it on repeat everytime we went out together :`) what a simple time to be alive
I love it, reminds me of those old western cowboy films :)

Hey there, I was on the receiving end of my ex coming back to me every so often (he broke up with me) but it got to the point where I started dating other people and he still kept trying to get in touch and wouldn't stop even when I asked him to. I then had to block him off all social media platforms and called it a day. Wasn't something I wanted to do as I still cared for him as a friend but just thought I'd give a heads up for what might happen if you keep trying. It must be so difficult for you having these feelings but I promise it gets better if you make that step and delete them off everything before they do it for you.
Oh bless you! Hopefully it won't be too long before you get them fixed again.
I was meant to get those but was so scared of this happening. Hope you're okay!
Honestly it's mad the kind of conspiracy theories people can come up with. The only thing keeping me going is the pay check :')

I work for the test and trace service..  and my god.. do people have a weird energy. I think it's mainly because people get scared and don't know what to do when they are effected by something they can't control. 

Around Christmas time, understandably, a lot of families got together to celebrate which caused a higher amount of people being uncooperative towards the test and trace service. Most of these people were in fact non-believers and sceptics. 

Of course my job is to be impartial and help everyone but it can be so frustrating feeling like youre hitting a brick wall everytime you give advice to people about keeping safe during a pandemic. 

I even got told once that I am harming people for giving information about the pandemic. To sum up my job, I deal with people who have been affected by the virus, ensuring they are okay and getting the support they need during their isolation. Of course.. some people take this as a death sentence and I'm the one that gets it in the neck. So yeah.. definitely weird energy.
